# I7 · Ảnh trước / sau

Group **I · Vận hành Clinic · bổ sung từ web** · detail screen · status: **ported**

> Web › studio · chọn góc chụp, so sánh cùng view; không tự căn chỉnh hay chấm hiệu quả

## Logic source
- Web: studio · chọn góc chụp, so sánh cùng view; không tự căn chỉnh hay chấm hiệu quả
- Web-only: logic ported from `prototype/shared/*.js` into the `shared/clinic` domain (`ClinicStore`, `transact` commands, `ClinicError` errors keep the web's Vietnamese messages).
- Permissions follow `prototype/shared/staff-context.js` (`pages` + `capabilities`) → `Session.allows` + `session.staffContext().can(...)`.
- Web `clinic.js` › studio() + photos(p): real photos = treatment sessions with an `image` for the same view; first = "Trước", last = "Sau"; none → illustrative images.

## KMP
- Route: `Routes.PhotoStudio` ("photo-studio") · app bar "Ảnh trước / sau"
- Composable: `PhotoStudioScreen` — `pema-kmp/feature/patients/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/pema/clinic/feature/patients/ClinicToolsScreens.kt`
- Registered by graph: `clinicToolsGraph`
- `shared/clinic` domain functions imported by the file (shared by every screen in it): `createPatient`, `daysBetween`, `patient`, `viDate`
- Shot test: `pema-kmp/feature/patients/src/jvmTest/kotlin/com/pema/clinic/feature/patients/ClinicToolsShotTest.kt:27` → `pema-kmp/feature/patients/build/shots/I7-vs.png`
- Canvas image: `pema-kmp/design-ref/I7.png`

- DetailScaffold(title = "Ảnh trước / sau")  // back button, padding 20

## Required canvas text (keep verbatim)
- Chưa kiểm định căn chỉnh ảnh; bác sĩ kiểm tra điều kiện chụp trước khi so sánh. Không suy ra hiệu quả y khoa từ ảnh minh họa.

## Business rules
- Entry point: the "Vận hành phòng khám" item at the end of each role's main screen (filtered by permission).
- "Thêm ảnh" like web `capture`: opens J5 "Ghi buổi điều trị" (photo attached to a session + photo consent).
- "So sánh trượt" only when there are 2 different photos.
- Slider comparison as on the web: the "Sau" photo is the background, the "Trước" photo covers the left part up to the slider position (`clip-path: inset(0 (100-v)% 0 0)`), label "Trước ← → Sau" at the top; "Trước"/"Sau" dates in the two bottom corners.

## Accepted differences from the canvas
- Web seed data (DAY = 2026-09-20, P001 Nguyễn Minh Linh) instead of the canvas's illustrative names/dates.

## Gotchas / notes
- Tested on a real phone: the first version was reversed ("Sau" on the left). The canvas doesn't draw slider mode, so follow the web.
